name: ChatGPT AI Product Description
summary: Bulk copy generator for Shopify from Profitonium: product descriptions, titles, meta tags and image alt text for thousands of products at once, in 30+ languages, with custom instruction templates and automatic descriptions on import. Live since 2021.
best_for: Shopify stores with catalogues in the thousands that need descriptions, titles, meta tags and alt text written in bulk and in several languages, and have the discipline to check a sample before running the whole catalogue
skip_if: you have a small catalogue where 100 free credits a month already covers the new arrivals, or your product copy is a differentiator you would rather write by hand
honest_knock:
First, the name is not a name. 'ChatGPT AI Product Description' describes a category, the app's own listing copy now calls itself Descrii AI Product Descriptions, and Shopify shows a different app by a different developer under a nearly identical name on the same page. Check the developer is Profitonium before you install.

Second, the credit is undefined and it is the only thing you are buying. Four tiers, one variable, no definition — and the '$1 per 100 descriptions' line repeated on all three paid plans is not the rate on two of them. Worse, the plan price may not be the whole bill: the listing carries Shopify's usage-based-charges line, and a merchant of twelve months, in a review edited 30 July 2026, itemised charges of $586.79, $487.49, $282.69 and $483.16 on top of a stated $149 a year plus $49 a month, marked 'billing cycle ended' and 'fee threshold reached'. That is one public account and the developer has not answered it on the listing, but nothing on the page lets you rule it out either.

Third, and the one that costs real money: this app edits your live store. Its permissions cover product descriptions and titles, Online Store pages and theme, files, locales, Shopify Markets settings, translations and navigation, and nothing on the listing describes versioning, a preview queue or a rollback. On 15 September 2026 a merchant of five months reported that it changed titles to products the store does not carry; the developer replied the next day that he had paused automatic generation for that store and was adding safeguards. The 529 ratings are strong — 504 five stars — but three are one star and they are the ones that describe undoing. Export your product CSV before the first bulk run. That is your rollback.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-20 on apps.shopify.com/automated-description-writing) Four tiers, priced in credits per month, all amounts unchanged since 19 August 2026. Free Trial: 100 credits a month. Basic $19 a month or $190 a year (save 17%): 2,000 credits, product descriptions, titles and meta descriptions, formatted descriptions, automatic descriptions on import. Standard $49 or $399 a year (save 32%): 11,000 credits, same features. Pro $249 or $1,990 a year (save 33%): 110,000 credits, same features plus priority video-call support. Every paid card repeats 'Only $1 per 100 Descriptions', which only holds at the bottom of the ladder: $19 for 2,000 credits is 95 cents per hundred, $49 for 11,000 is 45 cents, $249 for 110,000 is 23 cents. The listing never says what a title, a meta description or an alt text costs in credits. It also carries the standard line that recurring AND USAGE-BASED charges are billed every 30 days, and no usage rate or threshold is published anywhere on the page. The app's own copy now calls it 'Descrii AI Product Descriptions' while the listing title still reads 'ChatGPT AI Product Description'; the Works-with row names Claude, Gemini, GPT-5, gpt 5 mini and grok. Developer Profitonium, Adugodi, Bangalore; launched 12 March 2021; Built for Shopify badge; 4.9 from 529 ratings.
